theme.description: Grounded, tactile, physical. Uses organic colors to establish trust and connection with nature while maintaining an analytical clarity for a smart farming dashboard.

layout_and_spacing.containers: p-6, p-8 or p-12 for content areas, ensuring ample breathing room.

dashboard_grid.mode: MODE B: The Control Room Grid

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background (`bg-white`), sharp 1px border (`border-border`), no default shadow. On hover: `-translate-y-1` and `shadow-sm`.
surfaces.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border, no generic glassmorphism for analytics clarity.
surfaces.modals_dialogs: Solid white backgrounds with `shadow-xl` and 1px border. Dark scrim `bg-black/30`.

layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-md (6px) to maintain a crisp, analytical feel rather than overly playful soft edges.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Always explicitly define text color on hover. Darken border or subtle translation (`-translate-y-px`).
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties: `transition-transform duration-200 ease-out`, `transition-colors duration-200`.
motion_and_interaction.staggered_entrance: Use Framer Motion for list items and dashboard cards to stagger in on mount.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or `rounded-md`. Primary: `bg-[#1B4332] text-white hover:bg-[#2D6A4F]`. Secondary: `border border-[#E2E8F0] bg-transparent text-[#1E293B] hover:bg-[#F3F2EE]`.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn `Input` and `Select`. Minimalist style: solid border `border-[#E2E8F0]`, light background `bg-white`, focus state matches primary brand color.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Ensure color palette matches `brand` and `status` colors. No default bright neon palettes. Use earthy greens and terracotta accents.
components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned text, prominent column headers with uppercase small tracking styling.
components.sidebar: Fixed left, distinct background (`#F9F8F6` or `#FAFAFA`) to separate from main white content area. Active states indicated by bold text and primary color accent line.
components.cards: Cardless look or sharp borders. Remove thick default shadows.

hero_login_bg.description: Green and white tractor on green grass field, used for login screen background with an overlay.

dashboard_abstract_bg.description: Abstract modern topography lines in subtle earth tones. Can be used as a very subtle, low-opacity background behind key dashboard metrics or headers.

healthy_leaf.description: Healthy green crop leaf macro shot. Use in the Disease Detection section as a sample or success state.

diseased_leaf.description: Diseased crop leaf with brown spots. Use in the Disease Detection section to illustrate what to upload.

greenhouse_worker.description: Woman checking information while working in greenhouse. Good for onboarding or marketing banners.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text, especially on form placeholders and secondary info, meets APCA standards against `#F9F8F6` and `#FFFFFF` backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST have `data-testid` in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google fonts Manrope and IBM Plex Sans in the root HTML/CSS.
Implement a responsive sidebar layout for the dashboard.
Use Shadcn UI primitives but heavily customize them to remove soft Vercel shadows and rounded borders. Adopt sharp, crisp 1px borders.
Always apply `data-testid` for buttons, inputs, links, and actionable cards.
In the Dashboard Grid, strictly adhere to MODE B (The Control Room Grid). No floating, unaligned widgets. Ensure `h-full` to align bottoms.
For the Weather and Sensor Data, rely on typography tracking and weight for hierarchy rather than introducing random colors.
When displaying the crop leaf disease detection, use the provided `diseased_leaf` and `healthy_leaf` images as visual aids/examples before upload.
